question_set.question: Use highlight_path with path equal to PIP, Terminated and use calculate_conversion_rate with node_name equal to PIP and use filter_flow with min_value equal to 10.0 in order to know Analyze the talent attrition patterns in this HR lifecycle flow and recommend strategies to improve retention.

answer.value: The talent attrition analysis reveals several key patterns: (1) PIP is the primary attrition pathway with 45 employees entering PIP, and 26 (57.8%) being terminated - this is the dominant attrition flow. (2) Compensation-driven resignations (45 people) exceed growth-driven resignations (29 people), suggesting salary competitiveness issues. (3) The overall retention rate is 71% (291 out of 410). (4) S-Tier employees have excellent retention with 45 promoted and only 8 resignations. Recommendations: (a) Improve early performance detection to reduce PIP rates, (b) Review compensation structure to address the 45 compensation-related resignations, (c) Create more growth opportunities to retain employees seeking career development, (d) Strengthen the referral program which brings the highest volume (120) of hires.

key_insights: PIP leads to 26 terminations (57.8% of PIP cases)
S-Tier employees show excellent retention and promotion rates

reasoning_trace.rationale: Highlight the PIP to Terminated path to identify the main attrition flow
Calculate conversion rate at PIP node to understand performance management outcomes
Filter flows to analyze resignation patterns by reason
